opportunities.name: Stolen-resistance attack weave
opportunities.objective: Explore actual attacks while dismounted to use stolen defenses offensively.
opportunities.mechanic: Break the Mold steals armor/MR through attacks and abilities and attacks add 0.05 armor plus 0.05 MR magic damage. Dismounted W explicitly grants increased attack speed and defenses. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn test an attack component; Abyssal helps close magic damage and E or remount supplies access.
opportunities.requiredState: W dismounted state and finite stolen-resistance stacks are recorded; attacks can reach champions.
opportunities.failure: Delayed protective items and weak attack uptime can erase this offensive support gamble.
opportunities.test: Log stolen stats, passive damage and Dusk packets for identical dismounted attack counts.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Repeating on-hits need not repeat resistance-steal stacks; never grant unlimited theft.

opportunities.name: Shield-break full-tilt burst
opportunities.objective: Use Q shield destruction before the AP-scaled max-health E explosion.
opportunities.mechanic: Q destroys shields and stuns, with 0.6 AP damage. E next attack or Q explodes for max-health magic damage with an AP coefficient; R supplies two seconds of AP-scaled magic contact. Bloodletter and Liandry test sustained follow-up while Mandate requires Q/W immobilization rather than mere E speed.
opportunities.requiredState: Shielded durable target; arm E and hit Q before committing R/W.
opportunities.failure: Failing to land Q leaves the shield intact and the expensive AP package exposed.
opportunities.test: Compare Q shield removal, E explosion and R ticks at fixed target health and shields.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Shield destruction is not extra damage equal to the removed shield.

ruledOut.reason: Q and E have magic/AP effects; an ordinary AD spell-burst premise lacks their source ratios.

unknowns: W values are cross-referenced; inspected W calculations give 0.11 health shielding and AP damage. Steal floors, target-specific stacks and repeated on-hits remain unverified.

builds.summary: Explore actual attacks while dismounted to use stolen defenses offensively.
builds.goal: Explore actual attacks while dismounted to use stolen defenses offensively.
builds.hypothesis: Break the Mold steals armor/MR through attacks and abilities and attacks add 0.05 armor plus 0.05 MR magic damage. Dismounted W explicitly grants increased attack speed and defenses. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn test an attack component; Abyssal helps close magic damage and E or remount supplies access.
testPlan: Required state: W dismounted state and finite stolen-resistance stacks are recorded; attacks can reach champions.
Log stolen stats, passive damage and Dusk packets for identical dismounted attack counts.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Delayed protective items and weak attack uptime can erase this offensive support gamble.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeating on-hits need not repeat resistance-steal stacks; never grant unlimited theft.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Celestial Opposition, Dusk and Dawn, Nashor's Tooth, Abyssal Mask, Jak'Sho, The Protean, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
